Caps and max_duration unchanged (they already priced parent_g12 + parent_index). DRAFT, NOT SUBMITTED. First trained m2 cell (jobs/m2_first_cell/JOB_SPEC.md). Phase order: setup, guard, heldout, parent_g12, parent_index (live rate guard measures the box BEFORE training; jobs.m2_first_cell.reprice re-prices the child evals), cell, evals, report. Caps sized so a box up to 25 % slower than job-tkfaj (prefill and per-call latency) completes every scoring phase (projection <= 95 % of the cap); slower boxes stop before training. Worst case = (build_timeout + attempts x max_duration) x batch rate with attempts = 1 + max(max_restarts, assumed_restart_floor) (jobs/common/costs.py) = (60 + 2 x 637) x 0.0495 = $66.03. build_timeout 60 per the launch lint (L-09: image publish timeouts). Expected minutes: scoring phases at the job-tkfaj probe rates (TOK_S 3,757 at 2,048 tokens, CALL_S 0.117); training at the job-tvuat ADOPT step time (median 8.25 s, ckpt_rows_lean).

parent_arm_seed._note: LESSONS L-34: a resubmitted job starts with an empty checkpoint slot; this pinned export of the parent arm ships as data/parent_arm_seed/ (context.data below) and jobs.m2_first_cell.arm_seed installs it into $CK/parent_arm (sha + parent/cohort/unit-spec identity checked; exit 10 otherwise), so parent_g12 + parent_index (~68 GPU min) are skipped. Rate reports are not installed: reprice uses the seed_verify probe factor estimate measured on this box. Set arm_sha256 to null (and drop the three context.data entries) to score the parent in-job again.

Runs under the parent_g12 cap (it replaces both parent phases).
